name: nexora
description: Nexora Clinic – patient, appointment and billing management for outpatient clinics

scripts.dev: npm run dev:services && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm -w apps/api run dev" "npm -w apps/web run dev"
scripts.server: npm run dev:services && npm -w apps/api run dev
scripts.build: npm -w apps/api run build && npm -w apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w apps/api run typecheck && npm -w apps/web run typecheck
